title: Toxic Trait Test
description: Look at the darker side of your personality and identify unhealthy behaviors in your relationships with others.

questions.tox_1: I often manipulate situations so the outcome always benefits me.
questions.tox_2: If I'm at fault, I'd rather blame the circumstances or someone else so I don't look bad.
questions.tox_3: I find it hard to feel genuinely happy when a friend achieves something big.
questions.tox_4: I often leak other people's secrets as gossip to make conversations more exciting.
questions.tox_5: I think it's fine to lie now and then to avoid conflict or gain an advantage.
questions.tox_6: When someone hurts me, I plan how to get revenge.
questions.tox_7: I tend to feel that common rules don't apply to me if I'm clever enough to get around them.
questions.tox_8: I like stirring up trouble or arguments on social media or group chats just for fun.
questions.tox_9: I rarely apologize directly and prefer to act as if nothing happened the next day.
questions.tox_10: I often give fake (passive-aggressive) compliments to subtly bring someone down.
questions.tox_11: I easily lose sympathy for other people's problems that I think are trivial or stupid.
questions.tox_12: I get close to certain people only because they can give me status, money, or connections.
questions.tox_13: If I don't like someone, I try to influence others to dislike them too.
questions.tox_14: I often make promises or commitments I know from the start I won't keep.
questions.tox_15: When arguing, my main goal is to win, not to find a solution.
questions.tox_16: I tend to downplay other people's problems because I feel mine are far more important or serious.
questions.tox_17: I secretly feel pleased when I see someone I dislike fail.
questions.tox_18: I often play the victim to get sympathy or help.
questions.tox_19: When others set boundaries with me, I feel offended and try to push past them.
questions.tox_20: I believe being selfish and cunning is the only way to succeed in this world.

results.description: You interact with others honestly and have very good self-awareness.
You have some defensive or selfish traits, but you're not an intense manipulator.
Be careful: there are many manipulative, self-serving patterns that can damage your relationships.
